b9227f6263803503b923.text: In the previous part of the module, you have read the poem entitled “Context Clues.”

791f3d5d18200db1b995.text: What are some of the words that you find difficult to understand? How do you unlock the meaning of the words? What are the clues that help you solve them?

c8c46d2c05f06ea60589.text: This time, you study the sentences below. Take note of the underlined words. Can you

c99aaf62a9ba6ee44dee.text: 1. As a writer, Dr. Jose Rizal used several pseudonyms so as not to reveal his real identity.

9f68ac931c62ac000149.text: 2. We should always be prudent in what we say so as not to hurt the feelings of others.

7875dc2f5aa1edc0a975.text: Look at sentence number 1, what do you think is the meaning of the word pseudonyms?

0c885d8260768df0bbf2.text: How about in sentence number 2, what do you think is the meaning of the word prudent? The answer is careful.

6f60f83146740279179c.text: How did you know the answers? What words helped you identify the meanings of those unfamiliar words?

ca2a797917512ec395bb.text: The words not to reveal helped you identify the meaning of pseudonyms in sentence number 1 while the words not to hurt helped you identify the meaning of prudent in sentence number 2.

84c13dc8432f1a4fa629.text: One of the ways in determining meaning of words and expressions reflecting local culture is through context clues. These words served as the clues in the sentences.

cabd1f2d365750e2aacd.text: Context clues are words that appear in sentences to help understand the meanings of difficult words.

b30d835c4efdd1509233.text: Context clues are of different types: 1. by Definition

064f251aa280c8831221.text: • the unfamiliar word is defined in a sentence

b3f6aa82850b27690a31.text: An Archeologist is a person who searches for treasures from sunken ships and ancient tombs to obtain valuable relics, artifacts, and relics such as the Balanghai boat. (definition: a person who searches for treasures, artifacts, and relics)

dc9b4490c90b1940d80c.text: a similar word is placed in the same sentence to know the meaning of the unfamiliar word

8b54dc6d8f00a556293c.text: It is common for Filipinos to feel compassion or pity for the suffering of their fellowmen. (synonym: pity)

a9505eb2f30f35765d73.text: an opposite word is placed in the same sentence

63359a717c1dc0f1c90c.text: Among the siblings of thin body structure, Isabel is the only one who is portly. (antonym: thin)

d1337f9f0ae78bc74e2a.text: a similar word with the same meaning of the unfamiliar word is placed with an object to be compared

c8480a9e4c96fcbfeec5.text: The stench of the garbage was like the smell of a rotten fish. (comparison: rotten fish, means bad odor)

ebfc7da4ed2cc8a923b2.text: samples are provided in the sentence to understand the meaning of the unfamiliar word

0dd48c72634083912521.text: In ancient times, some of our forefathers believed in amulets, such as pearl of the crocodile, pearl of the ax, bullet necklace, and bag of herbs to protect them from harm. (example: pearl of the crocodile, pearl of the ax, bullet necklace, bag of herbs)

33ea26ccd84172204957.text: a description is given to understand the meaning of the unfamiliar word

ef75c67a8f96e8dc5f85.text: Matthew had few infractions of the house rules that he should have done as part of his responsibilities. (explanation: house rules that he should have done)

408c37a8388a0bad92b9.text: the meaning of the difficult word depends on the cause-effect relationship of other words as expressed in the sentence

38b436b498aa43edcb72.text: Since only a few followed the wearing of face mask, it was made mandatory by the government. (cause: only a few followed the wearing of face mask)

9b66afccb0d4bf749cef.text: 8. by List or Series of clues •

11c8599944879c2bc494.text: to understand the meaning of the unknown word, it is included in a series of words given in a sentence

c9f6a75f7ea4384b8c6d.text: After the program, the rubbish left such as souvenir programs, flyers, leaflets plastic bottles, and food wrappings were cleaned by the janitor. (list: souvenir programs, flyers, leaflets, plastic bottles, food wrappings)

17fa30767ddf9298cb48.text: to understand the meaning of the unknown word, one has to make a guess based on the description given in the sentence

5dd47a8ee8c7c6004942.text: When one shows hospitality, kind words and welcoming actions can be observed among Filipinos. (description: kind words, welcoming actions)
